title: path.resolve result, contract version 1
description: The result of path.resolve (PRD 5.9): the entry the placement found places, and the explanation of every step. The entry is there whenever the placement and its entry were read, visible or not, so a cache of the answer depends on its entry and node (PRD 9.4); it is null otherwise. It holds the fields of the entry's released revision only when the placement is resolved, and the query pipeline leaves out every field above the reader's classification access. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Routing\Domain\Dto\ResolvedPath, and the generated codec ResolvedPathCodecV1 writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

content.description: The entry the placement places, or null when the resolution did not read a placement and its entry.

explanation.description: Why the path resolves as it does.

here.description: Whether the path resolved is the canonical placement on its own site; false for any other placement and for a mount, whose source stays canonical.

placement.description: The canonical placement of the entry in the locale, or null when the reader can read none.

url.description: The canonical URL: the origin of the canonical placement's site with its node's route and its slug, or null when its node has no route or its site is not configured.

extension_fields.description: The extension fields, an object of fields by handle for each extender's namespace.

field_handle.description: A field's handle: lowercase snake_case of at most 63 characters without a double underscore, never ext and never starting with cms_.

field_namespace.description: An extender's namespace: 1 to 20 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter, never ext.

field_value.description: A field's value: a string, an integer, a boolean, null, a list of values or an object of values by a key of 1 to 255 bytes.

fields.description: The fields by handle, in the input form the type's validator reads: the owner's fields, and each extender's fields under ext by its namespace. A text, a decimal (its canonical string), a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a date-time (RFC 3339) are strings, an integer is an integer, a boolean a boolean, a list a list and a group an object of its fields. The kernel checks the values against the type's schema when it writes them.

mount_step.description: The route reached a mount (PRD 5.8): the slug is looked up below its source, and the placement found there is shown as it is.

source.description: The node the mount shows the placements of.

node_step.description: The node the route reaches (PRD 5.8, 5.9 step 2).

path_explanation.description: The explanation of the resolution, as path-explanation.v1.json describes it: each step it took in order and the outcome, named by the step that stopped it. Every key is always present; a step the resolution did not reach is null.

canonical.description: The canonical URL of the entry in the locale (PRD 5.7), or null when the resolution did not reach a placement the reader can read.

mount.description: The mount the route reached (PRD 5.8), or null when the node is not a mount or the resolution did not reach a node.

node.description: The node the route reaches, or null when the resolution found no route.

outcome.description: How the resolution ended, named by the step that stopped it: unknown_host (no configured site has the host), unknown_site (the host's site is configured, but no site has its handle), locale_not_published, no_route, no_slug (what is left of the path is not one slug), no_placement (no placement the reader can read has the slug), not_routable (the type has no URLs), not_visible (the precedence of PRD 6.6 blocks the placement) or resolved.

placement.description: The slug looked up below the node and the placement found, or null when the resolution did not reach the lookup.

route.description: The longest route of the site in the locale that is a prefix of the path, or null when the resolution stopped at the site.

visibility.description: The visibility decision at the time of the read, or null when the resolution did not reach a placement the reader can read.

placement_step.description: Step 3 of a resolution (PRD 5.9): the slug looked up below the node, the mount's source for a mount, and what was found.

canonical.description: Whether the placement is the canonical one of its entry in the locale.

entry.description: The entry of the placement, or null when no placement was found.

looked_under.description: The node the slug was looked up below: the node, or the mount's source.

placement.description: The placement found, or null when the reader can read none.

routable.description: Whether the entry's type has URLs, its blueprint's routable.

slug.description: The slug looked up: 1 to 255 characters without a slash or white space, and not . or ..

type.description: The entry's type, or null when the reader cannot read the entry.

read_content.description: The entry the placement places, with the node the placement sits under (the mount's source for a mount), its type and the fields of its released revision the reader may read.

fields.description: The fields of the entry's released revision in the input form, left out of the answer above the reader's classification access and empty when the placement is not visible.

node.description: The node the placement sits under, the mount's source for a mount.

route_step.description: Step 2 of a resolution (PRD 5.9): the path, and the longest route of the site in the locale that is a prefix of it. The routes looked up are the path's prefixes, the longest first: the path itself, each shorter run of its leading segments, and /.

path.description: The path requested, which starts with a slash: / or segments of no slash and no white space, at most 32 segments and 2048 bytes, without . or .. segments.

rest.description: What is left of the path after the route, which step 3 looks up as a slug, or null without a route.

route.description: The longest route that is a prefix of the path, or null when none is.

site_step.description: Step 1 of a resolution (PRD 5.9): the host to a site.

handle.description: The handle of the configured site that serves the host, or null when none does.

host.description: The host the path was requested at: a DNS name in lowercase with an optional port.

locale.description: The locale requested, a language tag such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS.

locale_published.description: Whether the site publishes in the locale; false when no site was found.

site.description: The site with the handle, or null when there is none.

time_window.description: A placement's window: from when and until when it is live, each null when it is open at that end.

from.description: The start of the window, RFC 3339 in UTC with six decimals, such as 2026-09-30T12:00:00.000000Z. Any offset is read. Null when it is open at the start.

until.description: The end of the window, RFC 3339 in UTC with six decimals, such as 2026-09-30T12:00:00.000000Z. Any offset is read. Null when it never ends.

visibility_step.description: The visibility decision (PRD 6.6, 6.7) at the time of the read, and what it was decided on.

at.description: The time the decision is for, RFC 3339 in UTC with six decimals, such as 2026-09-30T12:00:00.000000Z. Any offset is read.

decision.description: The rung of PRD 6.6 that decided, strongest first: entry_not_active (rung 2: the entry is not active, or the reader cannot read it), variant_withdrawn (rung 3), placement_withdrawn (rung 5), no_released_revision (rung 8), placement_hidden (rung 9: no window), before_window and after_window (rung 9), or visible (rung 11, live).

lifecycle.description: The entry's lifecycle, or null when the reader cannot read the entry.

release.description: The release state of the variant's head, or null when the reader cannot read it.

stored.description: The placement's stored visibility state in the locale.

valid_until.description: When the decision can next change because of the window, RFC 3339 in UTC with six decimals, such as 2026-09-30T12:00:00.000000Z. Any offset is read. Its end for a visible placement, its start for one whose window has not begun, and null when the window never changes it again.

window.description: The placement's window, or null when it has none.
